user.title: Heating control mode
user.description: Choose how to control your heating.

standalone.title: Standalone heating
standalone.description: Select the heater switch and the indoor temperature sensor for this space.

multi_zone_integrated.title: Integrated multi-room setup
multi_zone_integrated.description: Enter the number of rooms controlled by one Climate entity ({min_rooms}–{max_rooms}).

integrated_sensor.title: Shared indoor temperature sensor
integrated_sensor.description: Choose the single indoor temperature sensor for the integrated Climate entity.

integrated_room.title: Room heater switch
integrated_room.description:
Room {room_number} of {room_count}

Choose this room's heater switch.

heating_settings.title: Heating settings
heating_settings.description: Set temperature offsets, minimum heating and off times, and the learning observation report gap. The minimum off time is a floor; the longer of it and twice the preceding continuous heating run is used.

data.hot_tolerance: AUTO mode stop offset above target (°C)
data.heat_hot_tolerance: HEAT mode stop offset above target (°C)

preset_temperatures.title: Home and away preset temperatures
preset_temperatures.description: Set the default target temperature used by each occupancy preset.

optional_sensors.title: Additional temperature sensors
optional_sensors.description: Outdoor temperature supports outdoor-conditioned runtime predictions and the outdoor correction in predictive heating stop.

error.invalid_integrated_room_count: Enter a whole number from 2 to 32 for integrated control.
error.invalid_setting: Enter a value within the allowed range. Durations must be whole numbers.
error.invalid_entity: Select an existing entity of the correct type.
error.entity_unavailable: The entity state is unavailable. Restore it before continuing.
error.invalid_switch: Select a switch that reports an on/off state.
error.invalid_temperature: Select a temperature sensor reporting a finite numeric value.
error.invalid_unit: Select a Celsius (°C) or Fahrenheit (°F) sensor.
error.duplicate_heater: This switch is already selected in another room or integration setup, including setups in progress.

abort.invalid_step: Choose the heating mode and number of rooms first.
abort.entities_changed: The shared sensor or a previously selected room switch changed availability or ownership. Check the entities and restart setup.
